versions.subject: Merge PR #4961 from @tsale - Add multiples rules and updates
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\wscript.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains|all:
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp'
        - '.zip'
        - 'update'
        - '.js'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
        - 'Chrome'
        - 'Edge'
        - 'Firefox'
        - 'Opera'
        - 'Brave' # Not seen in campaigns
        - 'Vivaldi' # Not seen in campaigns
    Image|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
condition: selection
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\wscript.exe" ParentCommandLine="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp*" ParentCommandLine="*.zip*" ParentCommandLine="*update*" ParentCommandLine="*.js*" ParentCommandLine IN ("*Chrome*", "*Edge*", "*Firefox*", "*Opera*", "*Brave*", "*Vivaldi*") Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe")
